context:
Keep the contract small and ugly on purpose. A shared constant plus
a one-line assertion beats a generated TypeScript binding or an
OpenAPI-style schema for a surface this narrow. If the coupling grows
(more commands, richer output), revisit.
description:
The deterministic fixture corpus still shells out to
`benchbox explorer build`, but it no longer depends on a brittle
undocumented flag surface. The integration now has an explicit
contract:

1. `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/contract.py` declares the versioned
   build contract and required flags.
2. `benchbox explorer build-contract` emits that contract as JSON.
3. `results-explorer/scripts/validate-explorer-build-contract.mjs`
   checks the version/flags before fixture generation starts.
4. `tests/unit/cli/test_explorer_build_contract.py` pins the Python-side
   command surface so drift fails in the unit suite before the browser
   harness ever looks flaky.

anti_patterns.dont: replace the subprocess call with an in-process Python→JS bridge
anti_patterns.instead: keep the shell-out and add the version check alongside it.
anti_patterns.why: subprocess-based coupling is the only thing keeping the fixture generator deployable without a Node↔Python runtime

anti_patterns.dont: swallow the mismatch as a warning
anti_patterns.why: the whole point is to fail fast so the real root cause surfaces in CI

preserves.behavior: The browser suite remains the source of truth for user-visible coverage; this TODO only adds an early warning, not replacement coverage.
The fixture generator remains a single-entry `node scripts/generate-browser-fixtures.mjs` command - no new required env vars.
`benchbox explorer build` continues to work for all current callers (the fixture generator and any doc snippets).

verifications.description: The TODO item itself validates cleanly
verifications.expected: Validation passes with no schema or DAG errors

verifications.description: The Python contract test pins the flags the generator depends on
verifications.expected: Contract test passes; flag surface unchanged

verifications.description: The JS-side validator fails fast before fixture generation starts
verifications.expected: Validator exits zero and prints the aligned version, command, and required flags
